name: UK strikes & disruption
summary: Consultants in England strike from 25 Nov for 48 hours; RMT Tube strikes on 26 and 27 Nov, with more dates to February
state: The BMA said on 26 Oct that consultants in England will strike from 06:59 on 25 Nov to 06:59 on 27 Nov, providing Christmas Day level cover. National Rail listed on 6 Nov RMT strikes across the London Underground on 26 and 27 Nov, with further dates from 17 Dec to 25 Feb. In Northern Ireland, resident doctors plan to strike on 20–21 Nov and consultants on 23–24 Nov. These are strikes in single sectors, within the Watch band; no nationwide infrastructure failure was found as of 10 Nov.
for_you: NHS patients in England may see planned appointments rescheduled on 25–26 Nov; emergency care continues and the NHS advises using 999 and A&E as normal. Check TfL and National Rail before travelling in London on 26–27 Nov.
rubric_hit: National strike in one sector (consultants, England) plus Tube strikes; not multiple national strikes

sources.title: National Rail — London Underground industrial action

why: Strikes and infrastructure failures in rail, health, ports and power disrupt daily life and the economy.
drivers: Pay disputes, infrastructure failures, cyber incidents, weather.

rubric.alert: Multiple simultaneous national strikes, or nationwide infrastructure failure.
rubric.watch: National strike in one sector or major infrastructure disruption.
rubric.normal: No national-scale strikes or disruption this week.
